additional_info.subject: RE: ID0417993-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R5 170001861]charger is unavailable CRM:02681000064
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
As we received case from an end customer, we
found the error
“SECC_KF11_GenData_MB_Problem”
Kindly check following points which we have mentioned-
Regarding error"SECC_DC2_MB_Problem_KF11".
Check if SECC2300 of dispenser is available & connected
Restart the SECC,
usually this solves this problem.
Basically error "SECC_DC2_MB_Problem" indicates the Modbus connection problem. Checked the cables and connections. We can try rebooting only the SECC once. If still issue persists then we try to be replacing the SECC.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0417993-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R5 170001861]charger is unavailable CRM:02681000064
additional_info.body:
Hello, I was on site today, as the default appeared 01/05/2025 @ 18:43:21. I found the charger with both outlets unavailable. (LED where shut off)
After calling the regional field team, they asked me to transmit these pictures to help the diagnostic.
When closing the door sensor, QA1 is closed but then nothing happens ( no count of Power modules) Yet they are well powered.
Then I rebooted the charger, and it was fully operational until 17H12 when it got back in the same state.
Thanks for your help.
Théo  SALMON
Chargé d’exploitation IRVE
ENGIE Mobilités Electriques
theo.salmon@engie.com
+33 6 81 41 18 59
